diagram_candidates.rationale: The item constructs and identifies the listed reduced root systems and explicitly names their diagram types. A compact atlas would make classification outcomes easier to compare; editorial aid, not a defect.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show A_n as a chain; B_n and C_n as chains with the appropriate terminal double edge and arrow; D_n with its fork; F_4 with its double edge; G_2 with the triple edge; and E_6, E_7, E_8 with their forks. Label vertices by simple roots in chosen bases, point nonsimply-laced arrows toward the shorter root, and check the displayed G_2 Cartan matrix (rows (2,-1),(-3,2)) against its triple edge and orientation. Display only; no proof step should rely on it.
